Private & Confidential 1 Eragina Digital Solutions Pvt. Ltd. 
     Job Title: SAP Senior Consultant – Integration (PI/PO, CPI) 
Experience: 4–6 Years 
Location: [Insert Location or "As Discussed"] 
Company: [Insert Company Name if needed] 
 
  Core Requirements 
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI (HCI/Integration Suite) and SAP PI/PO 
• Strong background in designing and implementing end-to-end integration scenarios 
across modules and platforms 
• Proven ability to define integration architectures and API strategies 
• Experience integrating with cloud platforms (SAP, Salesforce, Azure, AWS) and 
IoT/external partners 
• Exposure to SAP ECC, S/4HANA, C/4HANA implementation projects 
 
       Key Responsibilities 
• Design, build, and troubleshoot integrations using SAP CPI and PI/PO 
• Lead deliverables with adherence to timeline, effort, and quality 
• Collaborate with onsite teams and mentor junior colleagues 
• Contribute to building internal knowledge and technical capability 
• Work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and global project environment 
 
🛠 Technical Skills Required 
• Development in SAP CPI, Process Integration (PI), and Process Orchestration (PO) 
• Strong in Java, Groovy, XSLT, ABAP, ABAP-OO 
• Adapters: SOAP, REST, IDOC, RFC, ODATA, HTTP, SFTP, File, JDBC, JMS, 
ProcessDirect 
• Data formats: JSON ↔ XML, CSV ↔ XML, etc. 
• Mapping: Java Mapping, Groovy, XSLT, graphical mapping 
• CPI Pallets: Message Transformations, Enricher, Splitter, Exception Subprocess 
• Integration tools: ESR, ID, RWB, SLD 
• SAP Interface Technologies: IDoc/ALE, RFC, Web Services, ABAP Proxy 
• SAP AIF (beneficial) 
• Secure integration: Security artifacts, encryption/decryption, certificates 
 
    Good to Have 
• Migration experience from SAP PI 7.x to PO 7.x 
• Passion for solving technical and business integration challenges 
 
 
Private & Confidential 2 Eragina Digital Solutions Pvt. Ltd. 
• Clear and confident English communication (verbal + written) 
• Motivation to grow technically and functionally in SAP domains
